observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached, placed on artificial grass. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 750D' clearly visible on the top. A lens cap with 'Canon' is also present.
Photo 1 shows the same camera inside an orange and black zippered case, with accessories like a battery, charger, and strap visible. The camera is secured in the case.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor wear, including scuffs on the body and lens.
No screen, sensor, or internal components are visible in either photo.
The seller's text claims it is a 'Canon EOS 750D (Rebel T6i)' with '24.2-megapixel APS-C DSLR camera, released in 2015'.

claims.claim: The camera is a Canon EOS 750D (Rebel T6i)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'EOS 750D' on the camera body and 'Canon' on the top. The Rebel T6i is the model name for this camera, though the seller's text uses 'Rebel T6i' which is a common misstatement; the model is EOS 750D.
No photo shows the sensor or screen to confirm megapixels. The camera's model (750D) is known to have 24.2MP, but this cannot be verified from the photos.
No photo shows the camera's serial number or date of manufacture. The model EOS 750D was released in 2015, but this cannot be confirmed from the photos.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turning on, screen displaying, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens barrel and front element, and a photo of the lens attached to the camera with the lens cap removed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens not included or damaged

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger inside the case, and a photo of the battery inserted and charging.

risks.risk: Camera may have internal damage or sensor issues
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's sensor with the lens removed, or a video of the camera's menu and settings.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens barrel and front element.
Photo of the battery and charger inside the case.
Photo of the camera's sensor with the lens removed.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
